methods.name: addDays
methods.description: Returns a string in ISO 8601 format that represents the date and time value of the provided string with the specified number of days added to it

methods.name: addHours
methods.description: Returns a string in ISO 8601 format that represents the date and time value of the provided string with the specified number of hours added to it

methods.name: addMinutes
methods.description: Returns a string in ISO 8601 format that represents the date and time value of the provided string with the specified number of minutes added to it

methods.name: any
methods.description: Returns true if the value is an array or string with contents, false otherwise (lambda parameter is optional)

methods.name: append
methods.description: Returns a string or array made from appending one or more strings or arrays onto them

methods.name: average
methods.description: Returns the average value found within an array of numbers  (optionally with a projection lambda)

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Returns true when an array or string contains the provided value

methods.name: currentDateTime
methods.description: Returns the current date and time as a string in ISO 8601 format

methods.name: currentDateTimeUtc
methods.description: Returns the current date and time in UTC as a string in ISO 8601 format

methods.name: default
methods.description: Acts as a catch-all in a match expression, always evaluating to true

methods.name: distinct
methods.description: Returns an array of items associated with distinct values of a specified property or scalar values

methods.name: endsWith
methods.description: Returns true if a string value ends with the provided substring, false otherwise

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates an arbitrary expression, either from a path or literal value, and returns the result

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Returns true if the provided value is not null, false otherwise

methods.name: flatten
methods.description: Returns a single array that is the result of recursively flattening an array of nested arrays

methods.name: foreach
methods.description: Evaluates a path and loops over the array elements or object properties it finds there to create its property values, naming the property as the string literal referred to by the arrow

methods.name: formatDateTime
methods.description: Returns a string that represents the date and time value of the provided string formatted according to the provided format string

methods.name: given
methods.description: Takes an expression and evaluates the result as a boolean, succeeding on true and failing on false

methods.name: groupBy
methods.description: Returns a JSON object that represents the grouping of an array's contents by its individual property values

methods.name: if
methods.description: Takes three parameters: a boolean condition, an expression to evaluate when that condition is true, and an expression to evaluate when false

methods.name: includeIf
methods.description: Takes a path or boolean condition and will evaluate and include the property's object if true, returning null otherwise

methods.name: indexOf
methods.description: Returns the zero-based index value of the first occurrence of the provided value

methods.name: is
methods.description: Takes a type literal, array pattern, object pattern, or scalar literal value and tries to match it against the value present in the #match expression

methods.name: isArray
methods.description: Returns true if the value is represented as an array, false otherwise

methods.name: isBoolean
methods.description: Returns true if the value is represented as a boolean

methods.name: isDecimal
methods.description: Returns true if the value is represented as a floating point number

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Returns true if the value is an array or string with no contents, false otherwise

methods.name: isInteger
methods.description: Returns true if the value is represented as a whole number

methods.name: isMissing
methods.description: Returns true if the provided path does not exist in the source document, false otherwise

methods.name: isNull
methods.description: Returns true if the provided value is null, false otherwise

methods.name: isObject
methods.description: Returns true if the value is represented as an object, false otherwise

methods.name: isRegexMatch
methods.description: Returns true if a string value matches the provided regular expression pattern, false otherwise

methods.name: isString
methods.description: Returns true if the value is represented as a string

methods.name: joinWith
methods.description: Returns a string that joins all elements of an array with the provided delimiter

methods.name: keysFrom
methods.description: Returns an array of the property names of an object

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of a string or array value

methods.name: match
methods.description: Matches a value against a set of conditions, evaluating from top to bottom and returning the value of the first one matched

methods.name: max
methods.description: Returns the maximum value found within an array of numbers  (optionally with a projection lambda)

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Returns an object that is the result of merging two or more objects together with a deep copy, with later values taking precedence over earlier ones

methods.name: min
methods.description: Returns the minimum value found within an array of numbers  (optionally with a projection lambda)

methods.name: nameOf
methods.description: Returns the name of the property being evaluated by the provided loop variable

methods.name: orderBy
methods.description: Returns an array in ascending order as determined by its individual property values

methods.name: orderByDesc
methods.description: Returns an array in descending order as determined by its individual property values

methods.name: parseDateTime
methods.description: Returns a string in ISO 8601 format that represents the date and time value of the provided string, requires exact format with optional format string

methods.name: reduce
methods.description: Returns a single value that is the accumulated result of applying a two-parameter lambda (the accumulated value and the current value) to each element of an array, with an optional seed value. Returns the seed value (if any) when the array is empty.

methods.name: regexReplace
methods.description: Returns the string value with all occurrences of a specified regular expression pattern replaced with another value

methods.name: removeAt
methods.description: Removes a JSON node from the provided variable-based path

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Returns the string value with all occurrences of a specified substring replaced with another value

methods.name: reverse
methods.description: Returns the string or array value with its elements in reverse order

methods.name: roundTo
methods.description: Returns the value of a provided number rounded to the specified decimal places

methods.name: select
methods.description: Returns an array of objects that are the result of a projection

methods.name: setAt
methods.description: Adds or modifies a JSON node specified with the provided variable-based path

methods.name: skip
methods.description: Returns an array excluding the leading elements of an array up to the specified count

methods.name: skipWhile
methods.description: Returns an array excluding the leading elements of an array that satisfy a specified condition

methods.name: slice
methods.description: Returns the array slice that falls within the provided range in a given array

methods.name: splitOn
methods.description: Returns an array of substrings from a string value splitting on the provided delimiter

methods.name: startsWith
methods.description: Returns true if a string value starts with the provided substring, false otherwise

methods.name: substring
methods.description: Returns the string value that falls within the provided range in a given string

methods.name: sum
methods.description: Returns the total value found within an array of numbers (optionally with a projection lambda)

methods.name: summarizeWith
methods.description: Returns an object array that's the result of applying an aggregate method to a grouped array's key and/or results

methods.name: take
methods.description: Returns an array containing the leading elements of an array up to the specified count

methods.name: takeWhile
methods.description: Returns an array containing the leading elements of an array that satisfy a specified condition

methods.name: toBoolean
methods.description: Returns a value converted to a boolean

methods.name: toDecimal
methods.description: Returns a value converted to a floating point number

methods.name: toInteger
methods.description: Returns a value converted to a whole number

methods.name: toLowerCase
methods.description: Returns the lowercase version of a string value

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of a value

methods.name: toUpperCase
methods.description: Returns the uppercase version of a string value

methods.name: transformWith
methods.description: Returns an object that is the result of transforming a document sub-path using a standalone transformer

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Returns the string value with all leading and trailing whitespace removed

methods.name: trimEnd
methods.description: Returns the string value with all trailing whitespace removed

methods.name: trimStart
methods.description: Returns the string value with all leading whitespace removed

methods.name: try
methods.description: Evaluates an expression and returns the result, or if an error is encountered it evaluates the provided lambda with the exception as a parameter and returns that result instead

methods.name: using
methods.description: Assigns a specific path to a range variable and allows statements to operate on it

methods.name: valueOf
methods.description: Gets the value of a property at the specified path

methods.name: valuesFrom
methods.description: Returns an array of the property values of an object

methods.name: when
methods.description: Conditionally executes a statement based on a boolean expression

methods.name: where
methods.description: Returns an array of objects that match a predicate

methods.name: zip
methods.description: Returns a single array that is the result of combining two arrays by pairs with a two-parameter lambda (the first element and the second element)
